title_zh: 选择远离湖岸的扎营位置

scenario.goal_zh: 比较营地位置并避开湖边危险区域。

context_zh: 迪伦抵达湖边营地，向管理员比较两处空位，避免把帐篷搭在封闭湖岸附近。
author: author-phase06-b

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: Can I put my tent on that flat patch beside the lake?

sentences.speaker: Campsite Warden
sentences.text: Not there. The ground beyond that rope is closed because part of the bank has collapsed.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: Is there another spot with a view of the water?

sentences.speaker: Campsite Warden
sentences.text: Try the southern edge of the field, beside the hedge. It's farther from the lake but sheltered from the wind.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: What about the open space near the gate?

sentences.speaker: Campsite Warden
sentences.text: You could camp there, but people walk through it all evening.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: I'll use the place by the hedge, then, and keep all my equipment on this side of the rope.

sentences.speaker: Campsite Warden
sentences.text: That works. The marked path from there leads to the water tap.
